faq.question: Why should Resources be a first-level navigation item?
faq.answer: Resources support both SEO and conversion. They attract long-tail traffic and help B2B buyers collect the documents they need before requesting a quote.

faq.question: Can downloads require lead capture?
faq.answer: Yes. The downloads collection already supports a lead capture flag, and the inquiry endpoint is prepared for source tracking and later CRM integration.

faq.question: What content should be added next?
faq.answer: Prioritize real datasheets, certification PDFs, installation guides, comparison articles and application-specific buying guides.

finalCta.title: Need a specific datasheet, certificate or guide?
finalCta.description: Send the product model, market and document requirement. Callsun can prepare the right file set for your project or sales team.
